monsters.name: Iron-Fanged Lycan
monsters.description: A wolf-type beast with razor fangs, one of Jinwoo's earliest trials.

monsters.name: Giant Statue
monsters.description: Colossal stone guardians from the Double Dungeon, capable of crushing hunters instantly.
specialEffects: Stone Smash (instant kill if puzzle failed)

monsters.name: Orc Warrior
monsters.description: Brutal foot soldiers armed with crude weapons.

monsters.name: High Orc Chief
monsters.description: A powerful chieftain commanding orc clans.

monsters.name: Kasaka (Blue Venom-Fanged Snake)
monsters.description: A giant venomous serpent that ambushes players in ruined areas.

monsters.name: Pyros, Infernal Sentinel
monsters.description: Elemental Fire Boss clad in molten armor, wields devastating flame attacks.

monsters.name: Neressa, Tidebinder
monsters.description: Elemental Water Boss, cloaked in streams and illusions.

monsters.name: Gravemaw, Stone Colossus

monsters.name: Zephyra, Storm Matron
monsters.description: Elemental Air Boss, commanding winds and lightning.

monsters.name: Cerberus
monsters.description: A massive three-headed hound that guards the inner chambers.
specialEffects: Triple Bite (3 consecutive attacks in one turn)

monsters.name: Baruka
monsters.description: A Demon Castle general wielding dark magic and blades.

monsters.name: Baran, Demon King
monsters.description: Demon King, one of the overlords of the Demon Castle.

monsters.name: Arch Lich
monsters.description: Powerful undead mages controlling skeleton armies.

monsters.name: Kandiaru, the System's Architect
monsters.description: The Architect of the System, testing hunters with deadly illusions.

monsters.name: Ant King
monsters.description: The apex predator of Jeju Island, feared even by S-rank hunters.

monsters.name: Frost Monarch
monsters.description: A powerful Monarch who commands ice storms and frost beasts.

monsters.name: Hwang Dong-soo
monsters.description: A rogue human hunter antagonizing Jinwoo and others.

monsters.name: Kang Taeshik
monsters.description: A corrupt hunter who betrays his comrades.

monsters.name: Architect Guardian
monsters.description: A hidden boss who manipulates dungeon structures and players.

monsters.name: Antares, Monarch of Destruction
monsters.description: The King of Dragons, Monarch of Destruction, the final antagonist.
